## Centipede, Great Forest (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
N Gargantuan vermin  
**Init** +1; **Senses** blindsense 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 7, flat-footed 23 (+1 Dex, +17 natural, -4 size)  
**hp** 238 (14d8+126)  
**Fort** +18, **Ref** +5, **Will** +4  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft., climb 50 ft.  
**Melee** bite +21 (4d6+22 plus grab and poison)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (4d6+22), poison  


**Statistics**


**Str** 41, **Dex** 12, **Con** 29, Int—, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 2  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +29 (+33 grapple); **CMD** 40 (can’t be tripped)  
**Skills** Climb +23, Perception +4, Stealth -3; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +8 Stealth  
**SQ** compression  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 26; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d8 Dex damage; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate or warm forest or underground  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or colony (3–6)  
**Treasure** none
